meta.title: feat: optimize avatar flashing during sidebar navigation
meta.body_summary: Optimize avatar rendering during sidebar navigation by reducing unnecessary API calls and re-renders, eliminating avatar flashing and improving navigation smoothness.

core_change_summary.description: Implemented tRPC staleTime/refetchOnWindowFocus in useMeQuery, added React.memo to UserDropdown and Avatar components, created UserProvider context to share user data, and wrapped Shell with it. Also added avatar URL memoization in defaultAvatarImage.ts, which was later reverted by maintainer.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The memoization cache in defaultAvatarImage.ts was reverted by maintainer in the final commit, indicating it may not have been needed or introduced issues.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add React.memo to UserDropdown, staleTime/refetchOnWindowFocus to useMeQuery.
Added UserProvider context to centralize user data, updated UserDropdown and useAppTheme.
Fixed circular dependency with ShellWithTheme wrapper.
Added avatar URL memoization and optimized Avatar components.
Maintainer reverted defaultAvatarImage.ts change and closed PR.
